messages:
anika: FYI — prototyped a 'hotplug' precision adapter that can switch between FP8/INT8/4bit per-request based on a QoS/profile. want quick feedback on safety boundaries and API shape.
rui: Nice. is the switch happening at request start or during generation (mid-token)?
anika: request-start only. plan: negotiate a precision_profile in the initial header, compile variant if missing, then stream tokens. no mid-token swaps to avoid KV mismatch.
jordan: KV cache concerns — quantization changes layout/scale tables. we need cache keys to include precision meta or a cross-quantized cache format.
anika: proposal: cache key = model-commit + precision-tag + prefix-hash. fallback: if precision mismatch, warm-start from prefix-only cache then rebuild rest.
sophia: kernel churn and first-request JIT will cause tail latency. how do we avoid big spikes on cold profiles?
anika: strategy: precompile popular combos on hosts (low-load windows), keep LRU of compiled variants per node, and limit compile CPU/GPU budget. also rate-limit on-demand compiles.
matthew: ops question — expose per-route config or per-request header? which is the default?
anika: both. default route setting = "auto" which picks cheapest profile that meets SLO. customers can pin route to fp16/fp8/int8/4bit or set header `x-precision-profile`.
rui: guardrails needed: only allow auto-downgrade if eval deltas vs baseline < configured threshold. need eval artifacts attached to profiles.
anika: yep — each precision_profile artifact will include metrics: perplexity-delta, rouge/bleu deltas, sample-failure-rate, hallucination-probe. store those as part of model metadata.
jordan: runtime fallback policy: if online quality probe detects regression, immediately fallback to safer precision and create incident. must avoid silent degradation.
sophia: telemetry: per-route/profile p50/p95 latency, cost_per_token, compile_time, and online-quality probes. alert when quality delta > X for Y minutes.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for route `/chat/gpt-like` with precompiles: [fp8, int8-auto].
matthew: add chaos test that evicts a compiled variant mid-session to ensure fallback doesn't corrupt KV and clients see graceful degrade.
anika: next steps: open RFC follow-up with interface draft + schema for precision_profile artifacts, eval fields, and cache-key semantics. will tag eng-runtime and eng-infra.
sophia: SGTM. please include an eval harness that measures hallucination rate on real prompt seeds, not just perplexity.
rui: minor but important — use fixed RNG seeds across precisions for deterministic eval comparisons to reduce noise.
jordan: also document memory footprint delta per-profile and max allowed compile_time for SLA math.
anika: thanks all. i'll iterate the RFC and drop the link here. tagging @eng-runtime @eng-infra for visibility. :party-parrot:
